NATIONAL FOREWORD
This Indian Standard which is identical to ISO 55001 : 2024 'Asset management - Asset management system - Requirements' issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on the recommendation of the Resources Management Sectional Committee and approval of the Management and Systems Division Council.
This standard was first published in year 2015 and was identical adoption of ISO 55001 : 2014 'Asset management - Asset management system - Requirements'. This revision has been broughout to align it with the latest edition of the ISO 55001 : 2024.
In this revision, the following major changes have been incorporated:
a) Application of the harmonized structure for management system standards, which includes the incorporation of the common core management system terminological entries in 3;
b) Inclusion of new subclauses dealing with asset management decision-making, the strategic asset management plan and knowledge;
c) Making clear that operational planning and control includes life cycle management;
d) Making a clear distinction between how an organization shall address “risk” and how it shall address 'opportunities';
e) Renaming the subclause 'preventive action' to 'predictive action' and full technical revision of the content of this subclause (see 10.3); and
f) A stronger emphasis on leadership and its role in supporting the enablement and success of the asset management system.
